allowlist.title: Allowlisted sites
allowlist.description: Hostnames where ClickFix Guard is switched off entirely. Each entry also covers its subdomains (github.com covers gist.github.com). Replaces the built-in list when set.

neverAllowlist.title: Sites users can never trust
neverAllowlist.description: Free/multi-tenant hosting domains (pages.dev, sites.google.com, ...). The banner's 'Trust this site' button is hidden on them and user-trusted entries never cover them. Replaces the built-in list when set.

threshold.title: Warning threshold
threshold.description: Score at which the warning banner is shown. Default 5.

allowUserTrust.title: Let users trust a site from the banner
allowUserTrust.description: Pilot switch. false hides the 'Trust this site' button and ignores every site users trusted earlier. Default true.

webhookUrl.title: Detection webhook
webhookUrl.description: Optional HTTPS endpoint that receives a POST for every detection. A Slack incoming webhook (https://hooks.slack.com/services/...) gets a formatted message with the page URL defanged; any other URL gets the raw JSON (page URL, score, indicators, time).
